essence: Undefeated conqueror grown great with auspicious wealth, knowledge-lit.
Milk-ocean Śaṅkara bowed; hate and praise both address Ambikā's husband who holds the all.
Vast Śambhu of withdrawn touch and full nectar; all-common supreme form undivided in division.
Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
Milked stainless Śiva-wisdom begged; offering carried to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being.

sections.SUMMARY: The undefeated conquers in auspicious wealth. Śaṅkara the milk-ocean receives homage; hatred and hymn alike reach Ambikā's husband holding all. Vast Śambhu wears withdrawn touch and full nectar; the all-common Lord stays whole in fracture. Sthāṇu spans mote and cosmos; the goose-power spreads wings over the egg; the picture blooms wall-less. Wisdom milked stainless from illusion's waters is begged for; the offering rests with undivided Bhava, one with the ultimate real.

rasa.justification: Each epithet widens the Lord (wealth, ocean, vastness, egg, milk); wonder at scale carried as praise-offering.
